cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount HYPE value recorded on cancelWithdrawal and read by redelegateWithdrawnHYPE
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

remainder_outside_accounting.meaning: the truncated conversion remainder of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount is left in the StakingManager contract outside totalStaked, hypeBuffer and validator delegation

assumptions: The remainder is the truncated conversion remainder of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount under the 1e10 divisor used by _convertTo8Decimals for SpotDeposit.
The lost remainder stays in the StakingManager contract rather than being sent to L1.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the accounting buckets (totalStaked, hypeBuffer, delegated amount) needed to express the outside-accounting relation numerically; only the qualitative outside-accounting condition is stated.
Report does not state whether the stranded remainder sits in an ETH balance or an L1 account, so the storage location of the outside-accounting value is unspecified.

limitations: The outside-accounting impact is formalized as a grounded Boolean because the report states the qualitative condition without numeric bucket definitions.
Per-call remainder magnitude (less than 1e10 wei) is not part of this target impact and is not encoded here.
